deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for Chrome extension, web/PWA, iOS, Android, and beta channel
Backend infrastructure and operations including multi-region servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync/indexers, application servers, metadata aggregation, monitoring, alerting, and incident response
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public channels, ecosystem project support, wiki updates, and educational videos
Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and implementation of oversight metrics
Pro plan rollout for personal and company users with on-chain recording of paid plans and reporting on Pro earnings
Repayment and donation mechanism to return surplus funds or later Pro-plan surplus to the treasury under stated conditions
request.what: 12 months of operations, maintenance, and improvements for the Eternl non-custodial Cardano light wallet, including frontend/backend work, infrastructure, support, administration, audits, and day-to-day operations.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to fund a 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027.
The proposal says Eternl costs around $420,000 per year and funds 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
The proposed budget allocates 55% to frontend, 25% to backend, 5% to support, 13% to admin, and 2% to audits.
Eternl says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The proposal states that an unaffiliated independent party will audit treasury fund receipt, custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro-plan income relevant to repayment, and repayments in February 2027 and August 2027.
Eternl claims an install base of about 100,000 browser-extension users and about 30,000 Android and iOS users.
Eternl claims that if about 4.2% of its install base, roughly 5,500 users, buy a Pro plan, Pro-plan income alone would cover the annual $420,000 cost.
Eternl claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The proposal states the main UI will not be open-source, while some Eternl libraries will be published through the npm registry.
The proposal says the Eternl DRep will abstain from voting on this proposal.

summary: The proposal seeks ₳2.35 million for one year of Eternl operations while it introduces paid Pro plans, with stated public-wallet custody, audit, reporting, and conditional treasury repayment mechanisms, but several key adoption and impact claims are asserted without evidence in the anchor text.
